scope: Proposition 5.3 (Jets from full-volume supports) of the manuscript “Maximal Multipoint Seshadri Constants in Higher Dimensions” (preprints/Maximal-Multipoint-Seshadri-Constants-in-Higher-Dimensions-October-5-2026/main.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 039 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 dc7a580f2b1d6cf6), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 15. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let n ≥ 2 and r ≥ 1 be integers, let w > 0, and set P = ∆(w, . . . , w, rw). Suppose that finite sets Fk ⊂ kP ∩ Zn, indexed by all integers k ≥ 1, satisfy Fk + Fl ⊂ Fk+l, #Fk = vol(P)kn + o(kn ). For every 0 < θ < w and every choice of distinct c1, . . . , cr ∈ C∗, the space M(Fk) surjects onto jets through degree ⌊kθ⌋ at (1, . . . , 1, ci) for all sufficiently large k.
